allocation_method: Direct joint transaction-cost-aware mean-variance utility over individual risky-asset weights
expected_return_estimation: 120-session adjusted-price momentum converted to a 60-session equivalent using geometric compounding
covariance_estimation: Regime-conditioned Ledoit-Wolf covariance blended with unconditional 252-session Ledoit-Wolf covariance
cash_only_conditions: No eligible risky assets, including previously held positions
Best incremental net mean-variance utility versus cash is non-positive
regime_definition: High volatility when 21-session SPY realized volatility exceeds the trailing 252-session median of realized volatility; threshold shifted by one session
execution: Signal at rebalance close; execution at next SPY session open; Spread and ADV at signal date; commission share price at execution open

spread_fallback_policy.lookahead: None; only observations strictly before signal date are used

benchmark: SPY buy-and-hold from first execution open, no fees
